home.title: Learning the Stock Market — Simple Notes
home.footer:
A note: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice. They are simplified on purpose. Markets carry real risk, and you can lose money. Before investing real money, do your own reading and, if it helps, talk to a SEBI-registered advisor.

Made with love, for learning. 💛

groups.label: 🔴 For the Curious — more advanced (higher risk)

pages.title: 1 · Stock Market Basics
pages.blurb: What a share is, where it's bought and sold, and who keeps it all fair.
pages.covers: why invest, shares, NSE/BSE, SEBI, Demat & broker accounts, IPOs, what moves prices, Sensex & Nifty, dividends/bonus/splits, getting started, glossary.

pages.title: 2 · Analysing Stocks
pages.blurb: The two ways people decide what to buy — and which suits a beginner.
pages.covers: fundamental vs technical analysis, simple ratios (P/E, ROE), and the beginner-friendly path.

pages.title: 3 · Personal Finance & Smart Investing
pages.blurb: Honestly the most important module — how to grow money safely over time.
pages.covers: emergency fund, compounding, mutual funds & SIPs, index funds, diversification.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice. Figures are rough illustrations, not promises. Markets carry real risk.

pages.title: 4 · Risk & Mindset
pages.blurb: How to stay safe, avoid common traps, and keep a calm head.
pages.covers: understanding risk, beginner mistakes, fear & greed, spotting scams, golden rules.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice. Markets carry real risk, and you can lose money. For decisions with real money, consider a SEBI-registered advisor.

pages.title: 5 · Mutual Funds (deep dive)
pages.blurb: The easiest way for most people to invest — explained properly.
pages.covers: fund types, NAV, direct vs regular plans, expense ratio, SIP vs lumpsum, how to pick a fund, ELSS.

pages.title: 6 · Taxes on Investing
pages.blurb: What you owe when you make money — kept simple.
pages.covers: short- vs long-term capital gains, how dividends are taxed, equity vs debt, and filing basics.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice. Tax rules change often — verify current rules. Markets carry real risk.

pages.title: 7 · Insurance Basics
pages.blurb: Protecting your family and your savings — the step that comes before investing.
pages.covers: term life, health insurance, how much cover you need, and why insurance ≠ investment.

pages.title: 8 · Technical Analysis
pages.blurb: Reading price charts — a peek into how traders think.
pages.covers: candlesticks & named patterns, trends, support & resistance, moving averages, volume, indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger), Fibonacci, risk-reward, and a big reality check.

pages.title: 9 · Futures & Options (Derivatives)
pages.blurb: The high-risk corner of the market. Read it to understand it — not to jump in.
pages.covers: what derivatives are, futures, options (calls & puts), leverage, and why most traders lose money.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice. Derivatives are very high risk. Markets carry real risk.

pages.title: 10 · Trading Systems & Strategies
pages.blurb: How rule-based trading works, and why discipline matters more than tips.
pages.covers: entries & exits, position sizing, stop-losses, backtesting, and a realistic look at the odds.

pages.title: Order Types Explained
pages.blurb: Market, limit, and stop-loss orders — with simple examples.

pages.title: Using Zerodha (Kite)
pages.blurb: A tour of the app — the order window, product types (CNC/MIS/NRML), and the Orders, Positions & Holdings tabs.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice, and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Zerodha. App screens change over time — check Zerodha's official pages for the current layout. Markets carry real risk.

pages.title: Expiry Explained
pages.blurb: What expiry is, weekly vs monthly, which day Nifty & Sensex settle — and what actually happens to a contract at the bell, including 0DTE.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice. Expiry days are set by the exchanges and can change — always confirm on NSE/BSE. Derivatives are very high risk. Markets carry real risk.

pages.title: Options Explained (Step by Step)
pages.blurb: The practical layer on Module 9: lots, strikes, premiums, the option chain, placing one on Kite — and the traps, minus the maths.
pages.footer: These notes are for learning only and are not financial advice, and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Zerodha. Numbers like lot sizes, margins, expiry days and charges are a snapshot as of the review date and do change — always confirm in the app and on NSE/BSE before trading. Options are very high risk; most individual F&O traders lose money.

pages.title: Glossary (A–Z)
pages.blurb: Every key term from across the notes, gathered in one place.

pages.title: Scam Safety Checklist
pages.blurb: Red flags, common scams, and how to verify before you trust anyone.
